summary: 9 OpenSpec changes. change-arc-001 (ratify goal 4 and 6 wording) MUST go first and is a human decision, not code — analyze deadlocked across 5 adversarial rounds precisely because those goals admit literal readings the implementation cannot satisfy. Then shared plumbing (002 fail-closed producer guard, 003 skill/agent packet modes) -> wire both creators (004, 005) -> prove it discriminates (006) -> user-requested additions (007 cap override, 008 cowork discovery + docs, 009 openai-proxy vendoring decision). 006 lands before 007-009 so the additions inherit a working gate rather than a claimed one.
ordering_rationale: 001 unblocks 002/004/005. 003 is independent and can run in parallel. 006 depends on 004+005 because it tests them. 007 depends on 006 for the working gate but ships its own override test.
warnings_carried: Changes 007-009 are user-requested scope extensions not tied to any of the seven phase goals; 007 modifies goal 5's cap rather than merely using it. Execute must either accept the extension explicitly or defer all three — nothing in 001-006 depends on them.
The <=6 judge-call budget for 006 is a ceiling, not a measurement; actual count depends on how many retry rounds the fixtures trigger.

caught_and_fixed: 006 claimed to assert 002's fail-closed behaviour but tested only verdicts — Group B added
005 omitted the 2-round retry loop 004 specified though goal 5 covers both creators
ORDERING BUG: 006 tested 007's override but runs before 007 — override moved into 007's own acceptance
007 conflated the sycophancy-screen cap with the retry-loop cap — now named separately
